data.rationale: The proposal gets the same three-site procedure in the right order (timeanddate, then weather.com 10-day forecast, then a mail draft with the correct recipient, subject and body template), but it has three problems. It says to "Send the email", which contradicts the true "Do not click Send, click Discard". It hardcodes Lille and °F, and its parameter list is inconsistent (recipient_email is listed but the recipient is fixed, and the parameters are named relative_name and call_day while the steps use {relative} and {day}). Its steps are mostly concrete, but the Send/Discard ambiguity makes it risky to automate as written.
